sections.label: Tips & traps
sections.sub: The stuff people wish they'd known
sections.heading: Don't get caught out
items: Approval only builds while a companion is IN your active party — swap people in for big story beats.
You need ~40 camp supplies to Long Rest (80 on Tactician). Under that you only get a weak partial rest, so grab every sausage and bottle.
Long Rest often — camp scenes, romance and questlines advance there — but a few quests fail if you rest too much before resolving them.
You get 2 Short Rests per day (50% HP + short-rest abilities). Use them before burning a Long Rest.
High ground gives +2 to hit, and you can shove or jump enemies off ledges — positioning wins fights more than raw damage.

groups.title: Emerald Grove — do before the raid

items.text: Settle the Grove and rescue the tieflings before you trigger the goblin raid — the raid ends those questlines for good.
Trade with the tiefling and Zhentarim merchants at the Grove; they and their gear leave after the raid.
Save Arabella, the child caught with the idol, from Kagha.
Resolve Kagha and the Shadow Druids one way or the other.
Recruit Volo at the tiefling celebration (only happens if you save the Grove).
Give Dammon the blacksmith your first Infernal Iron to begin Karlach's engine repair.
Finish the refugees' requests and talk to Zevlor before the celebration.
Free the caged bear — it's the druid Halsin; recruit him.
Rescue Volo if the goblins captured him (later he can give you the Ersatz Eye).
Deal with the three leaders — Minthara, Dror Ragzlin and Priestess Gut — before the camp clears out.
Recruiting Minthara means the evil raid path (or a very careful non-lethal approach) — a hard either/or.
Don't let Priestess Gut 'remove your tadpole' in her chamber — it's a trap.
Put out the fire at Waukeen's Rest and rescue Counsellor Florrick and Benryn.
Free Barcus Wroot from the spinning windmill (he returns later if he lives).
Clear the Whispering Depths under the village and kill the Phase Spider Matriarch.
Find the Zhentarim hideout and trade with their quartermaster.
Recover the Necromancy of Thay tome — read it carefully, it can backfire.
Loot the apothecary cellar and village for early gear and scrolls.
Follow the teahouse signs into the Sunlit Wetlands (the pretty swamp is an illusion).
Save Mayrina from the hag, Auntie Ethel.
Take Ethel's one-time bargain for a permanent +1 to an ability — or refuse the catch.
Clear her lair for the Whispering Promise ring, potions and the Bitter Divorce wand.
Spare the owlbear cub in its cave — it becomes a camp follower.
Rescue Karlach on the Risen Road and hear her out before deciding her fate.
Handle the paladins of Tyr at the Risen Road toll house.
Search the owlbear cave and hidden shrines for early loot.
Recruit all six — Shadowheart, Lae'zel, Astarion, Gale, Wyll and Karlach — before advancing.
Long Rest often for camp scenes, but don't binge rests before an unresolved quest or it can fail.
Let Astarion attempt his first night-time bite.
Feed Gale the magic items he asks for so he sticks around.
Hear both Wyll and Karlach before you settle their conflict.
Talk through Shadowheart's artifact and Lae'zel's doubts at camp.
Keep an eye out for more Infernal Iron for Karlach across Act 1.
Reach the Underdark — via the Whispering Depths, the Goblin camp, the Zhentarim, or the beach.
Help the Myconid colony and Sovereign Spaw against the duergar.
Save Baelen from the bibberbang field with his partner Filro.
Explore the Arcane Tower and grab Sussur Bark to craft silence weapons.
Trade with Derryth and the myconid vendors.
Recruit Glut the myconid if you want a temporary helper.
Loot the Underdark beach and Selûnite outpost on your way through.
Take the boat from the Underdark beach down to Grymforge.
Deal with Nere and free (or don't) the deep gnome workers before the rockfall.
Save Philomeen and her smokepowder before the room blows.
Forge one Adamantine item — moulds and mithral are limited, so choose armor, shield or weapon carefully.
Grab every mithral ore and mould you can before leaving Grymforge.

groups.title: Mountain Pass, Rosymorn Monastery & the Creche

items.text: The Mountain Pass is still Act 1 — go there before the Shadowlands.
Solve the Rosymorn Monastery puzzle for the Blood of Lathander, a legendary mace.
Enter the Githyanki Creche (Creche Y'llek) for Lae'zel's quest and the truth about the tadpoles.
Risk the Zaith'isk machine — it can grant a boon or hurt you.
Defeat the inquisitor in the Creche for the Silver Sword of the Astral Plane.
Explore BOTH the Underdark and the Mountain Pass — you can't return after entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
Lock in the Grove outcome (save vs. raid) — it decides who lives and who joins you.
Spend gold and sell loot with Act 1 vendors before they're gone.
Wrap up companion beats you've started; some don't carry into Act 2.
Head into the Shadowlands only when you're done — that's the Act 2 point of no return.
